acceptance.scope: isolated SQLite, both update owners; synchronous in-memory rollback including eviction
applied, repeated already_applied, missing-target and skipped-load controls
SQL trigger injection at fact/invalidation/relation; retry after trigger removal

limits: Runtime Memory persist remains retired. Tests enable only a test-process mocked flag resolver and simulated AUDN decisions; this is recovery-precondition validation, not restored product behavior.
SQLite tests use two real local connections. They do not prove live-model, cross-process cache freshness, every filesystem crash mode or GA.
Memory transactions accept synchronous internal mutations; the supplied persistence port owns rollback guarantees.
TF-0743 cache consistency and TF-0744 facade policy remain separate nodes.
Frozen-source results use the current test file with mapped pre-change runtime modules; new-API failures are not counted as independently observed partial writes.
